correctness.rationale: With vertex-edge pairing vertices indexed by 14 oriented edges, enumerated all 6!=720 injective orders using exactly the one-earlier-neighbor descending-link criterion. Independent recomputation produced 91 generator masks, 36 facets, complete 139 nonempty faces with f-vector (14,57,58,10). Reproducing the specified coordinate-toggle order yields 66 matched incidence pairs and seven critical masks 1096,1168,1296,1538,1664,2048,4160: one vertex, one edge and five 2-cells. The full 328-incidence directed Hasse poset is acyclic by topological sorting; exact signed integral unit-pivot elimination reduces every Morse boundary to zero. The one-skeleton is S1 and all five 2-cell attaching degrees in pi1(S1)=Z vanish, hence every attachment is nullhomotopic and the complex is S1 wedge five S2. This fully finite 720-order census is exhaustive, not sampling.
